{{Top|leg}}
'''Marsupials''' were a subgroup of [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] whose members were [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] one at a time incompletely developed and were typically carried and nursed in a pouch on the [[Parent/Legends|mother's]] belly. Although [[Reptomammal/Legends|reptomammals]] in fact had scaly skin yet but had fur instead for warmth, and gave birth to live young or laid their [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] and gave [[Milk/Legends|milk]] to feed their young, some of the species such as the [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] could be considered marsupials in terms of their mating process, as their cubs were developed within their mothers' pouches for a period of roughly three [[Standard month/Legends|months]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> Similarly, the [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] were normally nourished in a [[Brood pouch/Legends|brood pouch]] for the first fifty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of their life.<ref name="TCW:TVG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref>
